**D** is the better of the two options the team note allows, though I'd now reject my earlier answer A. Option D says a bar on receiving proceeds is enforced unless the contract says otherwise, while C overstates enforceability. I still think the modern UCC rule (§9-406(d), which applies because the distributor is selling goods) would make the assignment effective with only a damages claim against the distributor, so the note's answer conflicts with my reading.
CONFIDENCE: 40
